items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I had a band, and for some reason or other I called it the John Dillinger band.

ctx.x: But I remember as I said going to these different schools, but my next vivid thoughts were when I went to school in Columbia, Missouri, then it was that I had become quite mature in my mind, and I was playing music for parties in my junior high school year, up until the time I was a junior in high school, ready to graduate from high school. And it was during this time that I really remember playing for these parties, and would you believe it we had a band, I had a band, and for some reason or other I called it…
